LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models - arXiv

arxiv.org/abs/2106.09685     2025-03-31T00:00:00.0000000
We propose Low-Rank Adaptation, or LoRA, which freezes the pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each layer of the Transformer architecture, greatly reducing the number of trainable parameters for downstream tasks.

QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs - arXiv

arxiv.org/abs/2305.14314     2024-12-08T00:00:00.0000000
We present QLoRA, an efficient finetuning approach that reduces memory usage enough to finetune a 65B parameter model on a single 48GB GPU while preserving full 16-bit finetuning task performance.

LoRA Learns Less and Forgets Less - arXiv

arxiv.org/abs/2405.09673
We compare the performance of LoRA and full finetuning on two target domains, programming and mathematics, and find that LoRA substantially underperforms full finetuning in most settings.
